notes: The Andersons, Inc. (NASDAQ: ANDE). Diversified North American agribusiness — three reportable segments: Trade (grain origination/merchandising/storage; ~7M tons capacity Eastern Corn Belt + acquired Skyland 2024), Renewables (4 ethanol plants ~480MGY plus DDG byproducts; consolidated post-2021 buyout of LP partners), and Plant Nutrient (specialty fertilizers / lawn / homeowner). Fiscal year ends Dec 31. Data from SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts (CIK 0000821026). Note: ANDE does NOT report a US-GAAP `OperatingIncomeLoss` line in its consolidated statements — this segment of the income statement is gross-profit-driven (revenue − cost of sales/merchandising). EBITDA computed as net income before tax + interest + D&A using directly-tagged D&A. Shares from cover page (`EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding`). Revenue swung wildly with grain price cycle: FY22 record $17.3B (Russia/Ukraine spike); FY23 $14.8B; FY24 $11.3B (post-glut deflation). Skyland Grain acquired Apr 2024 (180M).

periods.notes: FY21: revenue $12.6B (+54% YoY) on grain rally + ethanol margin recovery. Trade gross profit boom; ELEMENT ethanol JV restructured. EBITDA approx pretax income + interest + D&A = ~$297M. Net income $104.0M, EPS $3.12.
FY22: peak revenue $17.3B on Russia/Ukraine grain price spike (corn / soy / wheat). Net income $131.1M, EPS $3.89 — record year. EBITDA approx $368M including D&A $134.7M.
FY23: revenue −15% YoY on grain price normalization. Net income $101.2M, EPS $3.00. Net cash position ($643.9M cash on B/S funded Skyland acquisition completed Apr 2024). D&A $125.1M.
FY24: revenue $11.26B (−24% YoY) on continued grain deflation, but EBITDA grew to $391.9M with Skyland Grain integration (Apr 2024, $180M) adding scale. Net income $114.0M, EPS $3.35. D&A $127.8M.
FY25: revenue $11.01B (−2% YoY) on stable but soft grain pricing. Net income $95.7M (D&A $133.3M). EBITDA approx $350M. Net debt $525M (cash drawdown for capex / Skyland integration).
